body: 2026-10-03: the owner merged all five PRs. #251 (shell) merged at 3af885bb, #252 (app icon) at def84d15, #253 (Meadow) at fccb9edc, #254 (onboarding) at ce4d20d6 and #255 (petals and waveform) at 9e41b3ba, which is the current origin/main.U+000AU+000ACI on the last two: #254 and #255 passed goldens, receipts and pr-title-lint (#255's goldens took 13m59s). #253 ran only receipts and pr-title-lint. No CI workflow runs on pushes to main, so main at 9e41b3ba, with #254 and #255 merged four minutes apart, had not been tested as a whole. A full suite (analyze, every test folder, impeller in both modes, garden under America/Edmonton) was started on a detached worktree at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/main-9e41b3ba.U+000AU+000ACleanup done, after confirming every branch tip is an ancestor of origin/main and every worktree is clean:U+000AU+002D Removed six worktrees: wave 1 trees proto-app-icon and proto-phone-shell, wave 2 trees proto-meadow, proto-onboarding and proto-petals-waveform, and fixup-shell. This freed about 1.3 GB.U+000AU+002D Deleted six local branches: mitosis/proto-{app-icon,meadow,onboarding,petals-waveform,phone-shell} and mitosis/prototype-phone-macos-base.U+000AU+002D Kept: the run directories' plan, state, lane, gate and ship logs (2.7 MB), and the handoff reports and renders under ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/handoff/.U+000AU+000Areceipts doctor (0.9.3) reports:U+000AU+002D The config is stale. Its verify.test_command (pub get, build_runner, flutter test) is set, but doctor detects no test runner.U+000AU+002D The config has no version stamp and no agent block.U+000AU+002D agent.observe is absent.U+000AU+002D It asks the library-project questions, which shows its detection misreads this Flutter app as a library.U+000AU+002D `receipts init --force` would overwrite the hand-set test command. This was not run; it is the owner's to decide.
